label: Intention-only double effect: condition 3 read as MEANS_2
definition: IntentionDoubleEffect c: as classical double effect, but condition 3 forbids only a harm that is a planned means (MEANS_2). Since MEANS_2 includes the plan, condition 3 is then implied by condition 2.
